name: Ranzan (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ranzan town emblem in navy: a ring crossed by two horizontal bands with a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Ranzan, a town in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 15 April 1967.

features.role: Ranzan town emblem — a ring crossed by two horizontal bands with a stylised character
